name: Fiery Rose
lede: A hot, slightly blue pink that sits between coral and a cut rose, used here to test the reference cards.

sections.title: In stone
sections.body:
The nearest cut stone is [[gem:spinel|spinel]], whose pink shade is a close neighbor of this color, and [[gem:ruby|ruby]] sits a little further off, darker and bluer.

A second paragraph with no reference at all, so the page shows that a card follows only the paragraph that names it.

sections.title: In paint
sections.body:
A painter who gave the color away to a cool wall: [[painting:nga-72328|Roses]], and the whole [[painter:john-singer-sargent|Sargent]] shelf, where the pink is a rare guest.

The same hue turns up in a [[look:art-nouveau|Art Nouveau]] palette and in the lantern red of [[film:raise-the-red-lantern]].

sections.title: In the garden
sections.body: Dyers took [[flower:madder|madder]] root to this red end of the scale, and a plain [[flower:mauve|mallow]] is nowhere near it.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: This is a fixture, not a reading.
